data.gender_notes: Giuseppa is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Italian tradition, the name Giuseppa is derived from the biblical figure of Joseph's wife, Asenath. In the apocryphal book of Joseph and Asenath, she is described as a beautiful Egyptian princess who is taken as a wife by Joseph. The name Giuseppa carries the meaning “Joseph's wife” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Giuseppa usually hope their child will grow to embody joseph's wife and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes faithfulness and loyalty in marriage.
data.etymology: Giuseppa belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joseph's wife.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Giuseppa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: ג'וזפא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ג'וזפא מקורו בשם העברי יוסף, שפירושו 'אלוהים יוסף, הוא יוסף'. השם יוסף מוזכר בתנ'ך כבן של יעקב ועלייה, וכאחד מ-12 שבטי ישראל. השם ג'וזפא הוא גרסה נשית של השם יוסף, ומשמש ככינוי לאישה שמבטאת את תכונותיו של יוסף.

in_greek.name: Γκιουζέπα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γκιουζέπα προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα יוסף (Yosef), που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός προσθέτει, αυξάνει'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο Ιωσήφ αναφέρεται ως ο πατέρας του Ιησού. Το όνομα Γκιουζέπα είναι η γυναικεία μορφή του ονόματος Ιωσήφ και συμβολίζει την πνευματική σχέση με τον Ιωσήφ της Παλαιάς Διαθήκης.

in_latin.name: Giuseppa
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Giuseppa originem habet in nomine hebraico יוסף (Yosef), quod significat 'Deus addit, auget'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Iosephus (masculine) erat nomen sacrum, designans fidelitatem et auxilium divinum. Nomen Giuseppa est forma feminina nominis Iosephus, significans mulierem quae virtutes Ioseph exhibet.

in_english.name: Giuseppa
in_english.long_meaning: The name Giuseppa originates from the Hebrew name יוסף (Yosef), meaning 'God will add, increase'. The name Joseph is prominent in the Bible, referring to the son of Jacob and one of the 12 tribes of Israel. Giuseppa is the feminine form of Joseph, symbolizing a woman with Joseph's virtues, such as faithfulness and divine assistance. Historically, the name Giuseppa has been used in Christian traditions to honor the biblical Joseph.

data.cultural_impact: The name Giuseppa holds a rich cultural legacy in Italian and Christian heritage. Redolent with a history steeped in love, sacrifice, and devotion, the name symbolizes the ideal virtues of a respected, loving, and strong matriarch. The name Giuseppa is often associated with women who exhibit unwavering faith, enduring love, and steadfastness, qualities that are deeply cherished in Italian and Christian culture.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Giuseppa is believed to invoke divine grace, blessings, and guidance from our Lady of Grace, St. Joseph, and the Blessed Virgin Mary. The name is often given to girls who are destined to become spiritual leaders and nurturers within their families and communities. The name Giuseppa is a reminder of the strength and grace of these biblical figures, who, in turn, inspire women to embody the virtues of love, faith, and courage in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Giuseppa, derived from Joseph in Hebrew, symbolizes the protective and nurturing qualities of a father figure. Spiritually, it represents the faith and steadfastness of Joseph, who trusted in God's plan, even in times of hardship.
